target_reader: People evaluating a VPS as a persistent remote workstation or Windows desktop.
intent: Informational/commercial investigation: decide whether a VPS fits remote-desktop use and how to choose resources.
existing_results_do_well: Explain what an RDP VPS is and how remote desktop access works.
Discuss latency, RAM and Windows requirements.
existing_results_miss: Clear separation between RDP as an access protocol and VPS as the server product.
Strong cannibalization-aware links to dedicated security/performance guidance.
Provider-neutral limitation cases where a VPS is not the right workstation.
unique_value: A decision and sizing guide that explains latency, application-driven RAM/CPU sizing and Windows licensing, while sending security/performance sub-intents to existing StealthRDP articles.
commercial_connection: Natural next step is comparing current VPS resource tiers after the reader knows whether remote desktop fits.
cannibalization: New URL owns selection/sizing. Existing RDP articles retain security and performance-optimization intent.
existence_question: Why should vps-for-remote-desktop exist when search already has competing results?
